method: Read the West State Motorsport Google Maps place found by searching West State Motorsport Federal Way. Opened Reviews, set Sort to Newest, and loaded 200 review cards through the newest window, reaching a displayed oldest review of a year ago. Counts are per review mention, normalized across McKay/Mckay/Mackey variants. last_90d uses displayed relative dates up to three months. negative counts 1-star and 2-star mentions. People are sorted by five_star descending. Top3 is limited to recurring retail-sales roles, balancing five-star volume with recency. Alex was excluded from top3 because the sampled reviews describe vehicle-acquisition work. Contact research checked the dealer contact page and public Google-indexed staff/social results. No direct cell or individual email was verified; the listed phone and email are dealer-level routes. No reviews were liked, replied to, edited, or submitted, and no dealer form or chat was used.
